meta.title: Sci-Hub / LibGen Fetcher
meta.description: Adds four tools. scihub_pdf / scihub_batch take a DOI or an article/PDF URL (or a list of DOIs), resolve them through Sci-Hub mirrors and download the paper PDFs into `scihub/`. libgen_search searches Library Genesis by keyword and returns hits with MD5, title, author, year, size and format; libgen_download fetches the chosen file by MD5 into `libgen/`, keeping its real extension (pdf/epub/djvu/...). All outbound requests support an HTTP/HTTPS CONNECT proxy via config.proxy or the HTTPS_PROXY / HTTP_PROXY / ALL_PROXY environment variables (NO_PROXY honoured), for networks where the mirrors are only reachable through a proxy. All files get consistent, human-readable names built from citation/hit metadata via fileNameTemplate (empty value restores the old DOI-based names) and are never silently overwritten. Mirror lists live in lib/mirrors.json and lib/libgen-mirrors.json and are re-read on every call; refresh Sci-Hub with `node update-mirrors.mjs`. Batches run with bounded parallelism (4 workers, results stay in input order), unreachable mirrors are skipped for the rest of the batch, and truncated downloads or browser-verification pages are rejected instead of saved.
